dedupe_keys.name: qgyf green space factor calculator qgis plugin c o city

description: QGYF is a QGIS plugin that calculates the green space factor, a measure of urban ecosystem services defined as the green and blue surface area plus an ecosystem service boost, divided by the hard surface area of a site. It implements the model developed by the Swedish foundation C/O City, which maintains the plugin; version 1.5 was released in July 2023 after releases since 2022. Planners and developers use it to score proposed designs of residential blocks and districts against green space factor targets set in Swedish municipal planning. Coverage is any development site. Format and access: a plugin in the QGIS repository for QGIS 3, with source code on GitHub and a tool page on the C/O City site. Licence: GPL-2.0; free. Caveats: the factor weights are set by the C/O City model and differ from other green area ratio schemes, and the plugin has not been updated since 2023. It supports design of green-blue infrastructure in new developments. Related catalogue records are the Berlin Biotope Area Factor, a similar planning ratio, and the NINA Oslo green roof prioritisation app.
